The Feast of Ten Heartstones
A pun-loving chef's recommendation: Prejudice in people's hearts is like a grand feast. I wanted to call it "Eat the Stonehearts," but the manager wouldn't let me... major sigh!
3,980,000 credits per table, minimum booking of ten guests
